name: Forerunner

frame.name: Full Stop
frame.description: Oversized Sidearm with extended-range, heavy-caliber rounds. Fires full auto with increased rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage to unshielded targets.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.description:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.description:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Pace Yourself
perks.description: Tapping the trigger gives this weapon less recoil and improves accuracy.

perks.name: Smooth Grip
perks.description:
This weapon is slightly easier to hold and aim.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: A new chapter for an old legend.

catalyst.name: Forerunner Catalyst
catalyst.description: For several seconds after a final blow, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to consume part of your ammo reserves, converting your next thrown grenade into a fragmentation grenade.
